item: Phase C blob store: design note + benchmark (R700, Q1009 rows 3-6)
status: design + benchmark only; no store change
summary: Benchmark of the current SQLCipher store vs a Phase-C prototype (HMAC-addressed, deduplicated, OOENC2-framed AES-GCM packs, crash-ordered writes): 4 MiB frames cost ~1.6 ms per single-article read, 64 KiB frames ~45 us (today 38 us); disk -22% at 20% duplicates, -44% with zlib. sqlite3mc not measured (wheel download refused by the sandbox safety check). Design note lists open questions Q-W1..Q-W8 for the coordinator.
